Shading compares Hobbs and Biggs with Hobbs and Lake in the 2022 Governor race: the change in two-party share, in full color at 5 points or more. Hobbs ran in both races, the other candidate did not, so this shows how much each party moved, not voters switching candidates. Hatching marks a county that a different party won in 2022.
